payload.reviewText: Completely disappointed. The product broke after just 2 days of light use. The build quality is terrible and it feels cheap. Shipping took 3 weeks when it said 5-7 days. I contacted customer service twice and got no response. Definitely not worth the money and I will not be ordering again.

The product itself is okay, but the shipping was a disaster. Package arrived damaged and took 2 weeks longer than expected. The headphones work fine but I'm not sure I'd order from here again given the delivery experience.

Absolutely love these headphones! The sound quality is incredible for the price point. They arrived in just 2 days with beautiful packaging. Battery lasts all day as advertised. When I had a small setup question, customer service responded within an hour and were super helpful. Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality audio without breaking the bank!

Great product overall — sound quality is excellent and the price is fair. Shipping was quick. The only downside is the ear cushions feel a bit stiff at first, but they soften up after a few days. Would definitely buy again.
